geometry_control_derivatives.claim_scope: Direct geometry-control autodiff agrees with centered finite differences on a three-harmonic owned surface. This is not yet a large VMEC/Boozer geometry-control validation.

file_backed_geometry_control_derivatives.claim_scope: Direct geometry-control autodiff agrees with centered finite differences on repository-owned file-backed Boozer and VMEC sample surfaces. This is stronger than the owned analytic audit, but it is still not a reusable geometry-family validation claim.

boundary_forward_mode_current_derivative.claim_scope: Low-dimensional boundary controls propagate through boundary-projected vmec_jax geometry, booz_xform_jax, NTX coefficients, and an NTX+NEOPAX integrated-current objective under forward-mode autodiff.

implicit_equilibrium_forward_mode_deriva.claim_scope: A representative low-order boundary control propagates through the implicit fixed-boundary vmec_jax residual solve, booz_xform_jax, and an NTX monoenergetic transport observable on the committed QA case. The equilibrium-volume derivative matches centered finite differences, while the Boozer and transport observables remain open on this implicit lane.

reverse_mode_diagnostic.error_message: Reverse-mode differentiation does not work for lax.while_loop or lax.fori_loop with dynamic start/stop values. Try using lax.scan, or using fori_loop with static start/stop.

explicit_relaxed_boundary_current_deriva.claim_scope: Low-dimensional boundary controls propagate through an explicitly relaxed fixed-boundary vmec_jax solve, booz_xform_jax, NTX coefficients, and an NTX+NEOPAX integrated-current objective under forward-mode autodiff on committed QA and QH family cases, while preserving the ordinary primal volume.
